verdict.rationale: First-party Firestore docs say apps can write, read, listen and query while the device is offline. They also say that when the device comes back online, Cloud Firestore synchronizes any local changes, and that offline support covers mobile and web. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of offline write sync, documentation of conflict-resolution behavior and cache limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build offline-capable clients whose local writes sync automatically on reconnect

citations.quote: When the device comes back online, Cloud Firestore synchronizes any local changes
Cloud Firestore caches data that your app is actively using, so the app can write, read, listen to, and query data even if the device is offline.
offers offline support for mobile and web
